thread:
Alex Chen: quick handoff for the overnight crew — TL;DR: starting 22:34 UTC we saw a coordinated spike of vector-store cache evictions on embedding-pool-A which caused KV miss amplification and higher embedding latencies. Some client requests hit 502s when we exhausted the retry window. PagerDuty page fired at 22:36 :rotating_light:
Maria Gomez: taking primary for the next 8h. I can be reached here or on my cell. Jamal is secondary and will handle infra escalations.
SRE Bot: alert: embeddings.error_rate > 1.5% for 5m, embeddings.p95_latency up 3x. Links: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/d/embeddings/evictions
Maria Gomez: current state —
- Affected services: hosted embeddings API (/v1/embeddings) and one internal prefetch worker
- Scope: ~7% of total requests seeing degraded latency; 4 customers reported 502s (Support ticket numbers: #4891, #4893)
- Mitigations in progress: temporary rate-limit increase on retry window, enabling soft-hits (allow stale KV) on pool-A, and slow rollout of a tuned eviction policy to reduce churn
Jamal Patel: infra notes — the eviction spike started when mem pressure on node set A crossed 82%. We suspect a background reindex job kicked off in eu-west-1 causing a working set expansion. I've paused the reindex and triggered an emergency compaction on the nodes.
Maria Gomez: commands run (paste from console):
```
# paused reindex job id 2026-03-13-77
reindexctl pause --job 2026-03-13-77 --region eu-west-1
# triggered compaction on pool-A nodes
kvadmin compact --pool embedding-pool-A --concurrency 3
```
Alex Chen: customer impact summary for handoff doc — 4 customers saw transient 502s, we retried/resumed for most and Support is following up. No data loss expected. SLA exposure: possible partial credit if errors exceed 0.5% for billing window (Support - Tier2 please verify).
Support - Tier2: noted, I'm drafting customer-facing messages for the three paying customers affected and will post a short status update by 23:15 UTC.
Maria Gomez: current mitigation checklist (what to watch overnight):
- monitor embeddings.error_rate and embeddings.p95 on the dashboard (alert if error_rate > 1%)
- watch eviction-rate metric for pool-A (critical if > 30 evictions/min sustained for 10m)
- ensure retry-window is not reducing successful client retries below 3 attempts
- if evictions persist, switch pool-A to soft-serve mode (instructions in runbook)
Alex Chen: runbook pointers: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vector-eviction and the kvadmin quick ops: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvadmin-ops
SRE Bot: scheduled reminder - review eviction metrics every 15m for the next 3 hours.
Jamal Patel: escalation criteria for infra pager:
- sustained eviction-rate > 50 evictions/min for 20m
- >10% client 502s for 10m
If met, page Infra Pager and stand up bridge: #infra-bridge on Zoom (link in runbook).
Infra Pager: acknowledged. If paged, I'll pull the node-level kernel logs and promote nodes to drained then restart kv service as needed.
Maria Gomez: potential coverage gap — between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC we have reduced on-call bandwidth (two engineers on PTO). If we see relapse near 02:00, I will escalate earlier to make sure someone is free to run node restarts.
Alex Chen: expected next steps for night shift — keep retry-window tweaks in place, monitor for relapse after compaction finishes (~10-15m), Support to post status update, escalate to infra if criteria met.
Support - Tier2: status message posted to affected customers and internal support channel. Will update with any replies.
Maria Gomez: FYI I will set a personal 30-min check-in alarm and re-evaluate at 23:00 UTC. If nothing regresses, we'll move to watch mode.
Jamal Patel: logs to check if symptoms return:
- /var/log/kv/eviction.log on pool-A nodes
- kvadmin top output: `kvadmin top --pool embedding-pool-A`
- application traces for embedding requests (traces tagged `eviction-suspect`)
Alex Chen: last note — documented everything in the incident tracker ticket INC-2026-EMB-77 (internal). Tagging @Maria and @Jamal on the ticket for ownership. Good luck, team. :coffee:
Maria Gomez: here and standing by.
SRE Bot: thread closed for handoff, will reopen on new alerts.
